changes.general: 2026-11-25: subset for Sutra+typing.works — only the hanja of our sutra texts; coordinates mapped from MMAH's 1024 grid (y up) to the unit square x/1024, (900 − y)/1024 (y down), 4 decimals; stroke outlines' quadratic/cubic curves flattened to polygons (max deviation 0.6 grid units) and simplified (Ramer–Douglas–Peucker, same tolerance); medians resampled to 16 points by arc length; strokes reordered to the KanjiVG order (Korean order) by matching normalised medians (Hungarian), allowing two strokes on one side to be matched as one unit where the two sources split or join strokes differently (a stroke continuing another — e.g. the ear of 阝 — or a horizontal split in two on one line — e.g. the 4-stroke 艹), medians reversed where KanjiVG draws the other way (order = kanjivg); where the stroke structures disagree too much MMAH's order is kept (order = mmah); in both cases a 艹 drawn as four strokes (十十) is put in the Korean order — left 一, left 丨, right 一, right 丨; each reordered character is described in changes.chars; 卽 (absent from MMAH) assembled from MMAH 白 + 匕 + 即's 卩; 25 more characters absent from MMAH in their Korean form (喫 淸 爲 擧 敎 旣 …) assembled the same way from MMAH components — parts moved into the boxes of the matching parts of an MMAH character of the same structure — or taken from an MMAH variant of the same shape (爲 ← 為); each is listed with its parts in changes.chars. This modified data is made freely available under the Arphic Public License at https://github.com/perskim/sutra-stroke-data.
